Name: Carnelian NPC - English translation
Author: SubspaceSoda
Description:
[size=5]
This mod includes:
[/size][size=4]-translated and rewritten dialogue

To put this in, have the Carnelian mod in the requirements downloaded first. Then place the folder into the mods folder. It should ask if you would like to replace files or skip them. Click replace. That should be it.

[/size]If it ever comes down to it, I may decide to make custom portraits, this all depends on how I'm feeling though. 
I assure you, I am not taking credit for a majority of the work, I just did the translation.
I did this purely out of a desire to learn what goes into the creation of custom NPCs and so I didn't need a translator.

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28118?]The mod I downloaded to find this[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7201]The original mod (outdated as far as I'm aware)

[/url]
﻿[size=4]Translation of the original introduction:[/size][size=3]
[/size]There was once a demon living in harsh environments, on a world tarnished and devoid of most life. In the midst of a long lasting war, the demon found himself gravely injured. With nowhere to go and a fear of death, the demon fled to a place entirely new to him, one that contrasted his old home entirely. He made the decision to stay in this odd place temporarily. If the farmer were to approach him, it could be possible to convince him to stay permanently.

To meet: enter the forest below the farm between 6:00-14:00 to trigger this one. This becomes available on Spring 8 of year 1.

Residence: to the south of Marnie's home, near the green onion patches. Walk across the boards to find it.

I am so sorry, I did not, in fact, check the gift rankings so I will give what I know and leave it at that.

Heart event triggers:

2 hearts: enter the forest below the farm on a sunny day after you get the pet. Triggers between 6:00-16:00
4 hearts: go to the beach on a sunny day between 20:00-23:00
6 hearts: enter the secret forest on a sunny day between 8:00-18:00
8 hearts: enter town on a sunny day between 8:00-18:00
10 hearts: go to the top of the mountain on a sunny day between 8:00-18:00. You have to have already seen the 8 heart event.
14 hearts: the total number of in game days must be more than 29. The letter to start the event can be received between 20:00-24:00
